title: K2 Space
description: A black aerospace palette: pure black ground, one soft grey ink (#c5c5c5) for every word, near-black planes (#141414 cards, #1b1b1b rows, #252525 square buttons) instead of shadows, quiet #5e5e5e links. Square corners, a slightly widened neo-grotesk at line-height 1. Light sibling: pale grey paper with graphite ink and the same square planes.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; the hero, quote and closer bands carry the `dark` class so footage keeps light text in light mode too
Archivo Variable at font-stretch 107% stands in for Telegraf (paid); blocks read the theme-only --k2space-stretch var
name: k2space-theme
